tools_helpful.evidence: Bulk Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml rewrite and scaffold set up the project; the agent proceeded straight to code-level fixes.

tool_limitations.limitation: Gates on build errors generically but has no targeted diagnostic for the app-namespace-shadows-a-WinRT-type (CS0118) case, so the agent had to root-cause it by hand.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Covered by prose fix; a script hint could point CS0118 'is a namespace but is used like a type' at the new PATTERNS anchor.

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP SDK sample uses it as a cross-page shared key-value store (holds the active socket, adapter list, etc.) across ScenarioN pages.
failed_apis.root_cause: CoreApplication.Properties does not exist in WinUI 3 desktop; there is no per-view CoreApplication singleton.
failed_apis.fix: Introduced a static AppState dictionary class and replaced every CoreApplication.Properties access with it.

special_apis.special_handling: The WinRT type name collides with the app's own root namespace (DatagramSocket), producing CS0118 'namespace but is used like a type'. Needed a using alias / full qualification.

errors_encountered.error: CS0118: 'DatagramSocket' is a namespace but is used like a type
errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP SDK samples are named after the API they demo, so the generated app root namespace (DatagramSocket) shadows the WinRT type Windows.Networking.Sockets.DatagramSocket; unqualified references bind to the namespace.
errors_encountered.fix: Add a using alias (using WinSock = Windows.Networking.Sockets;) or fully qualify Windows.Networking.Sockets.DatagramSocket at each use site.

errors_encountered.error: CS0103: The name 'AppState' does not exist in the current context
errors_encountered.root_cause: Helper AppState class was created in namespace DatagramSocket while ScenarioN files live in DatagramSocketSample; missing using directive.
errors_encountered.fix: Added 'using DatagramSocket;' to the scenario files (symptom of the same namespace layout issue).

errors_encountered.root_cause: Type resolution failures cascading from the unresolved CS0118 namespace collision and the CoreApplication.Properties removal until AppState was wired.
errors_encountered.fix: Resolved once the namespace alias and AppState replacement were complete.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: CS0118 'DatagramSocket is a namespace but is used like a type' plus cascading CS0246/CS0103 across scenario files
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~several build iterations around lines 9826-12440 of build-events.jsonl
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: App root namespace equals the demonstrated WinRT type name; the skill had no guidance for this collision.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent diagnosed the collision manually and added a using alias / qualified the type.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md build-error entry for CS0118 namespace-vs-WinRT-type collision (SDK samples named after their API).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: CoreApplication.Properties references would not compile; app used it as a shared dictionary across scenario pages
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: CoreApplication.Properties is unavailable in WinUI 3 and not mapped in the skill.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Created a static AppState replacement dictionary.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md entry mapping CoreApplication.Properties -> a static shared-state class.
